div.head: II Em 7
div.ab: Witan scylan fæhðe sectan: ærest æfter folcrihte slaga sceal his forspecan on hand syllan, ⁊ se forspeca magum, þæt se slaga wylle betan wið mægðe.
Witan scylon fæhðe sectan: ærest æfter folcrihtes laga slaga sceal his forspecan on hand syllan, ⁊ se forspeca magum, þæt se slaga wille betan wið mægðe.
Sapientum est sedare factionem: Inprimis iuxta rectam populi lagam debet prolocutor occisoris in manum dare cognationi, quod rectum ei per omnia faciet.
[Be fæhþe.] [Ld] Witan scylon fæhðe sectan: ærest æfter folcrihte slaga sceal his forspecan on hand syllan ⁊ se forspeca magum, þæt se slaga wille betan wið mægðe.

The authorities must put a stop to vendettas. First, according to public law, the slayer shall give security to his advocate, and the advocate to the kinsmen [of the slain man], that he [the slayer] will make reparation to the kindred.

Leading men must settle feuds: First, according to the common law the slayer must give a pledge to his advocate, and the advocate to the kinsmen, that the slayer is willing to pay compensation to the kindred.

(Über Rachefehde. Ld) Notable sollen Fehde beilegen: erstens soll nach Volksrecht der Todtschläger seinem Fürsprech, und dieser Fürsprech den Verwandten [des Erschlagenen] in die Hand geloben, dass der Todtschläger gegenüber jener Sippe Busse zahlen wolle.

(Of blood-feud. Ld) The witan are to settle feuds: first, according to folk-law, the slayer is to give a pledge into the hand of his advocate, and this advocate [is to give one] to the kinsmen [of the slain man], that the slayer will pay compensation to that kindred.
div.note: H's ‘sectan’ should be corrected to ‘settan’ from Ld; ‘folcrihte’ is Ld's reading (H, B and Quadr. have ‘folcrihtes laga’).
witan “wise men” seems here to be used more widely than its usual meaning of “councillors”.
